"Chef Full Video Songs" | "banjara song" | Latest Bollywood Songs 2017
Gulshan Kumar in association with Abundantia, A Bandra West Pictures Production presents the video song "Banjara" composed by Raghu Dixit, written by Ankur Tewari and sung by Vishal Dadlani from the Bollywood movie "Chef",The film is directed By Raja Krishna Menon, Produced By Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar, Vikram Malhotra, Janani Ravichandran & Raja Krishna Menon. Based upon the 2014 Hollywood hit by the same name, which was directed by Jon Favreau, Chef stars - Saif Ali Khan, Svar Kamble, Padmapriya and Chandan Roy Sanyal.
